<!-- agy-finding:a8013ea1a38489aa -->
**[P2 · logic]** Bypass of build/test check during file rename
_Confidence: 0.9_

The PR CI API query only extracts '.[].filename'. If a Swift file is renamed to a docs file, the removal of the Swift path (recorded in 'previous_filename') is ignored, allowing the build/test suite to be skipped despite deleting app code.

**Repair:** Update the API query jq filter to extract both '.filename' and '.previous_filename' from the changed files list.

```suggestion
            --paginate --jq '.[] | (.filename, .previous_filename) // empty')
```

<!-- agy-finding:f17b46346ee1ca7b -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in loadProfiles
_Confidence: 0.95_

loadProfiles() executes on a background cooperative thread after resuming from await, directly mutating @State variables.

**Repair:** Annotate loadProfiles() with @MainActor.

<!-- agy-finding:53501195b4ccd223 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in CreateProfileSheet.create
_Confidence: 0.95_

create() executes on a background cooperative thread after resuming from await, directly mutating @State variables and calling parent closures.

**Repair:** Annotate CreateProfileSheet.create() with @MainActor.

<!-- agy-finding:be6bc6549533a5e2 -->
**[P2 · logic]** State Mutation After Task Cancellation in loadProfiles
_Confidence: 0.9_

When loadProfiles() is cancelled, the caught error mutates errorMessage and isLoading after the view is dismissed.

**Repair:** Guard both success and catch blocks against Task.isCancelled.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `0a14f23fa027`.

<!-- agy-finding:53501195b4ccd223 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in CreateProfileSheet.create
_Confidence: 1.0_

The helper runs on a background cooperative thread and mutates @State properties after the await boundary.

**Repair:** Annotate the helper method with @MainActor.

```suggestion
@MainActor
    private func create() async {
```

<!-- agy-finding:07d50d31280e4f75 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in CreateProfileSheet.loadModels
_Confidence: 0.95_

loadModels() executes on a background cooperative thread and mutates @State private var modelGroups.

**Repair:** Annotate the loadModels() helper method with @MainActor.

<!-- agy-finding:f17b46346ee1ca7b -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in loadProfiles
_Confidence: 0.95_

loadProfiles() executes on a background cooperative thread after resuming from await, directly mutating @State variables.

**Repair:** Annotate loadProfiles() with @MainActor.

<!-- agy-finding:53501195b4ccd223 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Background Thread State Mutation in CreateProfileSheet.create
_Confidence: 0.95_

create() executes on a background cooperative thread after resuming from await, directly mutating @State variables and calling parent closures.

**Repair:** Annotate CreateProfileSheet.create() with @MainActor.

<!-- agy-finding:c3f8a84a96bf0736 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Unconditional token deduplication corrupts streamed text and code block indentation
_Confidence: 0.95_

The helper deduplicateToken is called unconditionally on all incoming stream chunks, stripping any overlapping characters at token boundaries.

**Repair:** Remove the unconditional deduplication or implement the replay-connection state guard present in the iOS version.

<!-- agy-finding:323223cf65497bb1 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Unobserved scrollToBottomEvent prevents auto-scrolling during response stream
_Confidence: 0.95_

The view model emits scrollToBottomEvent during streaming but neither ChatScreen nor ChatTranscriptView collects it, preventing viewport auto-scroll.

**Repair:** Collect scrollToBottomEvent inside a LaunchedEffect in the UI and trigger scrolling on the list state.

<!-- agy-finding:4d4592af808a1b97 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Stale cache check leaves session list blank on offline cold start
_Confidence: 0.95_

observeCachedSessions checks _isViewingCachedData.value at startup (which is false) and discards the cache, never re-emitting when the network subsequently fails.

**Repair:** Combine sessionDao.getAllSessions() with the _isViewingCachedData StateFlow so state changes trigger cache loading.

<!-- agy-finding:43ec3c1d93c8903b -->
**[P2 · logic]** SSE client fails silently on HTTP errors
_Confidence: 0.9_

onFailure terminates the flow silently when the connection fails with an HTTP error (where Throwable is null but Response is non-null).

**Repair:** Check for a non-null response inside onFailure and emit a corresponding SSEEvent.Error before closing the channel.

<!-- agy-finding:8a1c6b20f1b0d62b -->
**[P2 · logic]** Message action index lookup mismatch when messageId is null
_Confidence: 0.9_

editMessage and regenerateAssistantResponse look up messages by messageId instead of their stable unique id, causing action failures when messageId is null.

**Repair:** Use it.id == context.messageId instead of it.messageId == context.messageId in the lookup index search.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove unverified Git mutation endpoints**

These mutation endpoints are not in the verified API surface in `PROJECT_SPEC.md` §6, and `GitWorkspaceScreen` wires Commit/Checkout controls to them. On a normal `hermes-webui` server these calls will fail, and if a fork implements them they introduce workspace-mutating mobile actions outside the v1 scope; please remove or gate them until `api/routes.py` verifies the contract.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require auth validation before marking logged in**

When the server has password auth enabled and the user leaves the optional password field blank, this branch is skipped and `markLoggedIn()` still runs below, navigating into the app without a cookie or saved password. Since `authStatus()` is never consulted during connect, password-protected servers land on a broken sessions screen instead of prompting for credentials; check `/api/auth/status` and block blank passwords when auth is enabled.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Truncate before replaying the user prompt**

For regenerating an assistant reply, this keep count preserves all messages before the assistant, including the original user prompt, and the later `sendMessage(userText)` posts that same prompt again. In a one-turn chat the server history becomes `user, user, assistant`, corrupting context and usage; truncate before the replayed user message or use a retry-style server action instead.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude encrypted auth prefs from backup**

With `allowBackup="true"` and no `fullBackupContent`/`dataExtractionRules` attribute, Android's default backup policy applies. This app stores the server URL and password in `EncryptedSharedPreferences` named `hermex_auth_prefs`; the added `backup_rules.xml` is not wired here and even excludes `auth_prefs`, so credentials can be backed up/restored and the encrypted prefs may be unreadable after device restore. Disable backup or reference rules that exclude the actual auth prefs.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `a012de652ba4`.

<!-- agy-finding:6d6a382a856f8a3e -->
**[P2 · logic]** Blanket Exception Catch Bypasses Password Check on Connection Errors
_Confidence: 0.95_

The blanket catch catches all exceptions including network/connection failures, setting authStatus to null and letting passwordless logins to offline servers succeed.

**Repair:** Catch only ApiException.Http with code 404 and let other connection exceptions propagate.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Try HTTPS before HTTP for bare public hosts**

When a user enters a public tunnel host without a scheme, such as `hermes.example.com`, this stores `http://hermes.example.com`; `LocalCleartextInterceptor` then rejects that public cleartext request, and the onboarding HTTPS fallback never runs because the original input did not start with `https://`. That makes a valid HTTPS-only server fail to connect unless the user knows to type the scheme explicitly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep chat model selection session-scoped**

Selecting a model from the chat composer is a per-chat/per-send control, and `sendMessage()` already passes the selected model with `/api/chat/start`; calling `/api/default-model` here changes the server-wide default just because the user tries a model in one conversation. In that scenario, future new sessions and the Settings default can unexpectedly inherit this temporary chat selection.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reattach before ending transient SSE failures**

If the SSE connection drops transiently while the server stream is still active, for example through a mobile network change or Cloudflare idle interruption, `SseClient` reports `SSEEvent.Error` and this branch immediately clears `activeStreamId` instead of checking `/api/chat/stream/status` and reopening the stream. The agent can keep running on the server while the app shows the turn as failed and stops receiving the remaining response.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- agy-finding:cfd845188e5b3ce1 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Lack of re-entrancy guard in setSkill allows duplicate concurrent toggle requests
_Confidence: 0.9_

The method does not check if the skill name is already present in togglingSkillNames before running, allowing multiple concurrent requests for the same skill.

**Repair:** Incorporate a guard at the beginning of the function: guard togglingSkillNames.insert(name).inserted else { return }.

<!-- agy-finding:adcb6ed29bc48501 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Reverting entire skills array on toggle failure overwrites concurrent updates
_Confidence: 0.9_

Restoring a snapshot of the entire skills array on failure discards optimistic updates applied by other concurrent toggles in the meantime.

**Repair:** Remove the previousSkills snapshot and in the catch block update only the failed skill back to its original state: updateSkill(named: name, disabled: enabled).

<!-- agy-finding:fff049c91cd9a9ba -->
**[P2 · logic]** Skill name whitespace mismatch prevents optimistic UI updates
_Confidence: 0.85_

The updateSkill method matches the trimmed name against the untrimmed skill.name from the server, causing matching failures if the server returned whitespace.

**Repair:** Trim skill.name in the comparison guard: guard skill.name?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) == name else { return skill }.

<!-- agy-finding:77b9a8496fac8160 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Nested Toggle inside NavigationLink triggers navigation on toggle interaction
_Confidence: 0.9_

Placing a Toggle inside the label of a NavigationLink causes tap gestures on the toggle switch to propagate to the parent NavigationLink, resulting in unintended navigation to SkillDetailView when the user attempts to toggle the skill.

**Repair:** Separate the Toggle from the NavigationLink by placing them as siblings within an HStack, so only the non-toggle part of the row is wrapped in the NavigationLink.

Contested after empirical verification: manually tested on the iPhone 17 simulator (Debug build at bbbf054). Tapping the switch toggles the skill without navigating, and tapping the row body still navigates to SkillDetailView. The tap-propagation conflict described here applies to List rows; in this ScrollView/LazyVStack with .buttonStyle(.plain), the inner Toggle receives the tap. Resolving as not-reproducible.

<!-- agy-finding:cca44db91bb9dee1 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Scroll Position Instability and Visual Jumps When Prepending Items in LazyVStack
_Confidence: 0.9_

Prepending items to a LazyVStack during pagination breaks scroll position stability because the unrendered lazy views above the target have unknown heights, causing proxy.scrollTo to calculate an incorrect offset.

**Repair:** Revert to VStack or implement native scroll anchoring using iOS 17 scroll target layout APIs to preserve position.

<!-- agy-finding:e536461d8cdca97e -->
**[P2 · logic]** Fragile String Matching in Performance Guard Test
_Confidence: 0.95_

The unit test reads the source file and asserts on exact string matches of code lines, which will fail on formatting changes or if the target string appears in a comment.

**Repair:** Use a regular expression that ignores comments and arbitrary whitespace, or verify the view type dynamically.

Fixed in e255fa2. The blanket `catch (_: Exception)` is replaced with `catch (e: ApiException.Http)` that only treats HTTP 404 as a legacy server (no auth endpoint). All other exceptions — connection errors, timeouts, network failures — now propagate up to `runWithHttpsFallback` → `handleConnectionError`, which surfaces the appropriate error message instead of silently bypassing password checks.

Fixed in e255fa2. `ApiClient.configure()` now defaults bare hosts (no scheme) to `https://` instead of `http://`, so public tunnel endpoints like `hermes.example.com` work without the user having to type the scheme. The `httpFallbackUrl()` in `OnboardingViewModel` is updated to also handle bare-host HTTP downgrade, so local/private LAN servers (e.g. `192.168.1.100:5000`) still fall back to HTTP when the HTTPS TLS handshake fails.

Fixed in e255fa2. `selectModel()` no longer calls `apiClient.defaultModel()`. Model selection is now purely session-scoped — it only updates local UI state (`currentModel`/`currentModelProvider`), which is passed to `/api/chat/start` when sending a message. The server-wide default is no longer affected by per-chat model picks.

Fixed in e255fa2. On SSE error (connection drop, network change, Cloudflare idle timeout), the client now calls `/api/chat/stream/status` to check if the server-side stream is still active. If `active == true`, it reattaches by reopening the SSE connection with `isReplayingConnection = true` for token deduplication. Only if the server confirms the stream is no longer running (or the status check itself fails) does it finalize and show the error.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `e255fa2aa9ce`.

<!-- agy-finding:68c538e7daedcfe0 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Asynchronous stopStreaming call cancels the server-side stream during reattachment
_Confidence: 0.95_

startStream calls stopStreaming() which asynchronously sends a cancel request to the server, cancelling the active stream we wanted to keep running.

**Repair:** Replace stopStreaming() call in startStream with streamingJob?.cancel() to only cancel local subscription.

```suggestion
streamingJob?.cancel()
```

<!-- agy-finding:55775b3167288661 -->
**[P2 · logic]** isReplayingConnection is not reset to false upon failed or empty reattachment
_Confidence: 0.95_

isReplayingConnection is set to true during reattachment, but is only reset to false when a non-empty token remainder is processed. If the reattachment fails or completes with no tokens, it remains true and corrupts the next normal message.

**Repair:** Reset isReplayingConnection to false inside resetStreamingBuffers().

Addressed in `da1883d`. I kept the `LazyVStack`, but opted the transcript stack into native scroll-target registration with `.scrollTargetLayout()`.

The pagination path already captures the current first visible `renderID` before `onLoadOlderMessages()` and restores it with `proxy.scrollTo(renderID, anchor: .top)` after the prepend; registering the lazy rows as scroll targets makes that restore path explicit without reverting to eager layout.

Verified with focused `ChatTranscriptViewPerformanceGuardTests` and the full `HermesMobile` XCTest suite on iPhone 17.

Addressed in `da1883d`. The guard now strips block/line comments before matching and uses whitespace-tolerant regular expressions instead of exact trimmed-line string matches.

I also extended the guard to assert that the lazy transcript stack has `.scrollTargetLayout()` so the pagination anchoring fix stays coupled to the performance change.

Verified with focused `ChatTranscriptViewPerformanceGuardTests` and the full `HermesMobile` XCTest suite on iPhone 17.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `da1883da03d0`.

<!-- agy-finding:cca44db91bb9dee1 -->
**[P1 · logic]** Scroll Position Instability and Visual Jumps When Prepending Items in LazyVStack
_Confidence: 0.95_

The scrollTargetLayout() modifier is a no-op because the container ScrollView does not bind a scrollPosition(id:) variable, causing pagination to jump during lazy view prepends.

**Repair:** Declare a scroll position ID state property, bind it via .scrollPosition(id:) on the ScrollView, and assign it the captured visible row ID during pagination load.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid cancelling active streams during reconnect**

When a transient SSE failure reports `status.active == true`, this reattach path calls `startStream(streamId)`, but fresh evidence in this revision is that `startStream` immediately calls `stopStreaming()`, which still sees the same `currentStreamId` and sends `/api/chat/cancel` before the replacement SSE is opened. On mobile network blips or Cloudflare reconnects this cancels the server-side agent run (and can cancel the newly assigned `streamingJob`) instead of reattaching; skip the server cancel when reopening an existing stream.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle completed stream status before surfacing an error**

If the SSE drops after the server has completed but before this client receives `done`/`stream_end`, `/api/chat/stream/status` can return `active: false` with `done: true`; this branch treats every non-active status as a stream error and only calls `finishStream()`, so the completed assistant response is never reloaded from `/api/session`. Check `status.done` (and any status error) and call the normal completion/reload path instead of leaving the transcript partial.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Observe launch requests outside the sessions screen**

Because pending VIEW/SEND intents are only passed into `SessionListScreen`, a new intent delivered while the singleTask activity is already showing chat, settings, or another child route has no composed consumer and is never acted on. In that context, tapping a response notification for another session or opening a new-chat deep link leaves the user on the current screen; handle `pendingLaunchRequest` at the nav-host level or navigate back to the sessions route before delegating it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Request notification permission before dropping notifications**

On Android 13+ this returns without posting response-complete notifications unless `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` was already granted, but this commit never requests that permission (the only `RequestPermission` launcher in the app is for `RECORD_AUDIO`). Fresh installs targeting SDK 36 therefore never receive completion notifications; request or prompt for the notification permission before relying on this path.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in `831675b`. The transcript now keeps a state-backed `transcriptScrollPositionID`, binds it on the `ScrollView` with `.scrollPosition(id: $transcriptScrollPositionID, anchor: .top)`, and assigns the captured visible `renderID` during older-message pagination before and after the prepend.

I kept the existing `ScrollViewProxy.scrollTo(renderID, anchor: .top)` call as a fallback after layout yields, so the pagination path now has both native scroll-position anchoring and the previous explicit restore.

Verified again:
- `git diff --check upstream/master` — passed
- focused `ChatTranscriptViewPerformanceGuardTests` — passed
- full `HermesMobile` XCTest suite on iPhone 17 — passed

Fixed in e2035b9. `startStream()` now calls `streamingJob?.cancel()` instead of `stopStreaming()` — this cancels only the local SSE coroutine subscription without sending `/api/chat/cancel` to the server, so the server-side agent run continues during reattachment.

Fixed in e2035b9. `resetStreamingBuffers()` now resets `isReplayingConnection = false`, so stale replay state from a failed or empty reattachment doesn't carry over and corrupt the next normal streaming message.
Fixed in e2035b9. Same fix as the Hermes finding — `startStream()` now uses `streamingJob?.cancel()` instead of `stopStreaming()` to avoid sending `/api/chat/cancel` during reattachment.

Fixed in e2035b9. `handleStreamError()` now checks `status.done == true` and calls `finalizeMessage(null)` which reloads the full transcript via `loadMessages()` and sends the response-complete notification. Server-reported errors (`status.error`) are also surfaced instead of the generic SSE error message.

Fixed in e2035b9. `pendingLaunchRequest` is now observed via a `LaunchedEffect` at the `HermexNavHost` level. `OpenSession` requests navigate directly to the chat screen from any route. `NewChat` requests navigate to the sessions screen first (if not already there) so `SessionListScreen` can handle session creation.

Fixed in e2035b9. `MainActivity` now requests `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` permission on Android 13+ (TIRAMISU) at startup using `rememberLauncherForActivityResult`. The permission prompt is shown once on fresh installs; if denied, notifications degrade gracefully (the existing `notifyResponseComplete` already checks permission before posting).
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `e2035b93676c`.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `e2035b93676c`.

<!-- agy-finding:cca9fee9ea41e336 -->
**[P2 · logic]** Duplicate navigation trigger for OpenSession launch requests
_Confidence: 0.95_

Both HermexNavHost and SessionListScreen execute LaunchedEffect(pendingLaunchRequest) concurrently when on the SESSIONS route, pushing the chat screen twice.

**Repair:** Remove the OpenSession block from SessionListScreen's LaunchedEffect.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reauthenticate before loading chat directly**

When the app process is restarted, the `CookieJar` is empty, and `SessionListViewModel` is the only caller that retries a 401 by logging in with the saved password. A notification/deep-link `OpenSession` is handled at the nav host and navigates straight to `ChatScreen`, so this direct `apiClient.session(...)` call fails with `Unauthorized` on password-protected servers and never recovers; wrap chat API calls in the same reauth path or persist/rebuild the auth cookie.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove unhandled non-text share targets**

This wildcard SEND filter makes Hermex appear for image/file shares, but `HermesLaunchRequest.fromParts` only creates a launch request for `ACTION_SEND` when `EXTRA_TEXT` is non-empty. Sharing an image or arbitrary file therefore opens the app and drops the content with no upload/attachment flow; keep only `text/plain` until stream/URI attachments are actually consumed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the bare-host URL expectation**

`ApiClient.configure()` now intentionally defaults bare hosts to `https://`, but this test still asserts the old `http://` behavior for `192.168.0.157:8787`. The unit test will fail as soon as it runs, obscuring the HTTPS-default fix; update the expected URL/name or cover the HTTP fallback separately.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Fixed in b096628. **Root-cause fix**: `HermexNavHost` is now the **sole** consumer of `pendingLaunchRequest`. The `LaunchedEffect(pendingLaunchRequest)` block and `pendingLaunchRequest`/`onLaunchRequestConsumed` parameters have been removed from `SessionListScreen` entirely. A new `LaunchRequestViewModel` handles `NewChat` session creation at the nav-host level, eliminating the duplicate navigation path. The `LaunchedEffect` is also guarded with `authState == LOGGED_IN` to prevent deep links from navigating into chat during onboarding.

Fixed in b096628. **Root-cause fix**: Added a centralized `HermesAuthenticator` (OkHttp `Authenticator`) that transparently handles 401 retry-with-login for **all** API calls and SSE connections made through the shared `OkHttpClient`. This covers ChatViewModel, SessionListViewModel, and every other caller without each needing bespoke reauth logic. The authenticator POSTs to `/api/auth/login` with the saved password, using the shared `CookieJar`, and is guarded against infinite loops (skips login endpoint, respects `priorResponse`). The previous `withAuthenticatedClient`/`reauthenticate` in SessionListViewModel has been removed as redundant.

Fixed in b096628. Removed the `image/*` and `*/*` SEND intent filters from AndroidManifest.xml — only `text/plain` is kept since `HermesLaunchRequest.fromParts` only handles `EXTRA_TEXT`. Also removed the unused `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` and `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permissions (no attachment/upload flow exists yet). Both will be re-added when the `/api/upload` UI is implemented.

Fixed in b096628. **Root-cause fix**: Consolidated URL normalization into `ServerUrls.kt` with two shared functions (`normalizeServerUrl`, `httpFallbackUrl`) that both `ApiClient.configure()` and `OnboardingViewModel` delegate to — no more duplicate/diverging logic. Updated the stale test assertion to expect `https://` for bare hosts (matching the new default), renamed the test to be accurate, and added comprehensive test coverage: explicit `http://` preserved, `https://` preserved, whitespace trimming, and all `httpFallbackUrl` branches (https→http, bare→http, http→null). All 11 tests pass locally.
✅ Resolved — no longer flagged as of `b09662874530`.

<!-- agy-finding:aeec180ada94298f -->
**[P2 · logic]** Empty check block in HermesAuthenticator causes redundant concurrent login requests
_Confidence: 0.95_

The block intended to allow retrying the original request when another thread has already refreshed the cookie jar is empty. As a result, even if fresh cookies exist, the authenticator falls through to send a redundant /api/login request.

**Repair:** Return the original request when valid cookies already exist.

```suggestion
                return originalRequest
            }
```

<!-- agy-finding:fc0489c26a2ddeab -->
**[P2 · logic]** Transient network failures during reauthentication force user to Onboarding on configuration change
_Confidence: 0.9_

The generic catch (_: Exception) block handles all exceptions (including IOException from connection timeouts or DNS resolution issues) by calling authManager.markLoggedOut().

**Repair:** Catch IOException separately and return null without modifying the authentication state.

<!-- agy-finding:2be799428fb9a10b -->
**[P2 · logic]** ViewModel leak and lost navigation event on configuration change
_Confidence: 0.9_

The navigation callback lambda passed to LaunchRequestViewModel.createSession captures the local navController instance. Because the ViewModel is scoped to the Activity's lifecycle, the callback survives configuration changes while the network call is in flight.

**Repair:** Expose navigation events from LaunchRequestViewModel using a SharedFlow or StateFlow and collect them inside the composable's LaunchedEffect to perform the navigation on the active NavController.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle replayable stream status before failing**

When a dropped stream is no longer `active` but the server still has a replay journal, `/api/chat/stream/status` returns `replay_available: true` (the repo's Swift reconnect contract tests cover reopening `/api/chat/stream` with `replay=1`). This Android model/handler has no replay field or branch, so that case falls through to `sendErrorMessage` and `finishStream()`, abandoning recoverable long-running responses after a disconnect or server handoff.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update pinned sessions after a successful toggle**

When the user pins or unpins a session, this mutation result is ignored and `_sessions` is never updated or refreshed. The server can accept the change, but the row stays in its old section with the old pin state until a manual reload, making the pin action appear broken and leaving the cached session list stale.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Intercept slash commands before sending them as chat**

For any advertised non-client command such as `/model`, `/workspace`, `/reasoning`, `/retry`, or `/branch`, `handleClientSlashCommand()` returns `false`, so this path sends the slash text to `/api/chat/start` as a normal user message. Those commands are shown in autocomplete as actionable/no-echo controls, so using them corrupts the transcript instead of changing app/server state or showing the unsupported-command fallback.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Cancel active streams from a scope that survives clearing**

An uncertain reply that arrives after its request has already left no longer sets a warning. Refusal messages are tied to their request the same way.

**Project checks reject new source** `WatchVoiceNoteTranscription.swift` is now included in the phone target, but it is absent from both the saved fixture and `AUTHORIZED_IOS_WATCH_COMPANION_SOURCES`. The extra-file check in `test_existing_target_configuration_and_memberships_are_preserved` therefore rejects this addition. Add the new source to the allowlist so teammates can run the project checks successfully.

**Older start deletes new recording** Two quick recording starts can overlap because `capture.phase` stays idle while `recorder.begin` waits for microphone permission. If the newer attempt starts recording first, the older attempt fails its `voiceAttempt` check and calls `recorder.cancel()` on the shared recorder. That deletes the newer clip but leaves its recording panel open. Ignore an abandoned attempt that no longer owns the recorder, or prevent overlapping starts.

**Removed server stays visible** Removing the last server on iPhone now leaves the watch showing that removed server and its old sessions. `loadRegistry` ignores every empty snapshot when `servers` already contains entries, including a successful response confirming that no servers remain. The phone then rejects the still-enabled watch actions. Distinguish a failed registry request from a confirmed empty registry, and clear the watch state for the latter.

**Watch stays on Connecting** When the phone confirms that its last server was removed, `applyRegistry` clears the selected scope but leaves `servers` populated. On the next foreground refresh, `refreshConnection` sets `.connecting`. If the phone fails to answer, the unavailable-response branch returns early because the old `servers` array is still nonempty. The watch stays on “Connecting” even after the request times out. Clear `servers` when accepting a confirmed empty registry, so a later failed request settles on setup instead. ```suggestion servers = [] registryRevision = snapshot.revision state = .setupRequired adopt(nil) ```

**Deleted matches come back** While the same search runs again, its old matches stay actionable. If the host reads the search before a delete, rename, or pin finishes, but replies afterward, `searchHermes` replaces the updated matches with that older reply. Its guards check the query, client, and Profile, but not writes made during the request. A deleted session can reappear and fail when opened; other matches can lose their updated title or pin. Keep confirmed changes when applying an older reply, or discard and repeat that search.

**Archived rows get skipped** Load two pages, start restoring `s150`, then pull to refresh before the host refuses. The refresh replaces `pages` with page 0 and sets `nextOffset` to 100. This refusal then inserts `s150` into the new pages through `restore`, raising the offset to 101 even though those pages never removed that row. Load more skips `s100`. Keep refreshes from replacing pages during a restore, or rebuild the pages after a refusal instead of applying the old rollback.
**Chinese command text is broken** The new Simplified Chinese description for `/clear` contains `新��天`, so users see broken characters in the command panel. Replace it with `新聊天`.

**New project leaves session behind** Choosing New Project from a session's Move to Project menu loses the session being moved. If the user changes the prefilled folder, Save creates the project and closes the sheet, but the session stays in its old folder and never joins the new project. Keep the session in `HermesProjectCreation` and move it to the saved folder after creation succeeds.

**Read marks finish out of order** Marking a row unread and then opening it starts two separate PATCH requests. The older `unread: true` write can reach the host after the newer `unread: false` write, leaving an unread dot on Desktop and bringing it back on the phone after refresh. The `mark.id` check ignores the older reply but cannot undo its host write. Send writes for each session in order, or send the latest value again after an older write finishes.

**Cached messages disappear after compaction** `newestRowIDs` assumes row IDs follow transcript order, but compaction re-inserts the first rows under higher IDs. After a long compacted transcript is cached, reopening it reads only the newest page. An earlier cached row with a higher ID falls inside this range even though the page never covered it, so `cacheHermesMessages` deletes it. Track which part of the transcript was actually covered instead of treating every higher ID as covered.

**Failed reads hide saved messages** The new transcript fallback only runs when attaching fails. If the socket and session resume succeed but the first `sessionMessages` read fails with a timeout or 502, `readNewestRows` catches the error and the attach still completes. `hermesHistoryDidFail` then sets an error without reading the available cache. The user sees an empty chat instead of the saved read-only transcript. Route eligible history-read errors through the cache fallback too.

**Deleted messages still appear** If `session.undo` succeeds but the transcript reload fails, `undo()` shows an error and returns normally. `undoHermesExchange` then reports success and unlocks Send, while the deleted exchange still appears in the chat. A user who retries `/undo` to remove that visible exchange permanently deletes another exchange instead. Keep Send locked until the transcript is rebuilt, and do not report the command as completed when its reload failed.

Valid. Two marks for one session went out as separate PATCH requests, so the older one could land last and stay on the host. Fixed in 93ec1c8a: `setHermesUnread` keeps each session's latest write, and the next write waits for it to land before it sends. `testASessionsMarksReachTheHostInTheOrderTheyWereMade` holds the unread write and checks the read write is not sent until it lands. Before the fix it failed with `("2") is not equal to ("1")`.

**Older replies restore outdated projects** A list reload and a create, rename, or delete can call `readHermesProjects` with the same `hermesReadSerial`. If the earlier tree request finishes last, this guard accepts it and overwrites the newer projects and session groups. A created project can disappear, or a deleted project can return, until another refresh. Give tree reads their own request counter so only the latest reply applies.

**Successful moves show no message** When a session has no listed previous folder, `moveHermesSession` returns `nil` even after the host successfully moves it. This guard treats that result as failure and skips the success message. Return success separately from the optional Undo folder, then show “Moved” even when Undo is unavailable.

When readNewestRows fails after session.undo succeeds, undo() reports historyFailure via delegate but does not throw, causing undoHermesExchange to return .executed, unlock Send, and leave the deleted messages visible.

**Repair:** Throw historyFailure in HermesChatTurnCoordinator.undo() so undoHermesExchange catches the failure, calls holdForLostAnswer to lock Send via isHermesSubmissionUncertain, and returns .notDelivered.

**Search returns to wrong Profile** When a chat opened from the Sessions list starts a new chat in another Profile, `/sessions` and `/resume` return to the original Profile’s list. `ChatViewModel` builds the destination with the current chat’s Profile, but `onOpenHermesSessions(entry.query)` drops that Profile. Users see the old Profile’s sessions, and a named `/resume` that falls back to search searches the wrong Profile. Pass the destination’s Profile back too and select it before searching.

**Search keeps stale results** When a search is already active and a refresh falls back to cached rows, `showCachedHermesSessions` leaves `hermesSearchRows` and `hermesSearchSnippets` untouched. `visibleSessions` still adds those old host results, including rows the cache never saved. The fallback also does not queue the search for retry, so stale results can remain after reconnecting until the user changes the query. Clear the host search results when entering cached mode and queue the active query for the next successful list read.

**Refresh keeps deleted matches** Pull-to-refresh and reconnect do not repeat a completed host search. `openHermes` reloads pages, but this guard only retries searches that failed before attachment. If another device deletes a match outside the loaded pages, `loaded[result.id] ?? result` keeps showing the saved match after refresh. Tapping it opens a deleted session and fails. Repeat the active search when refreshing or reconnecting, not just when it previously failed to attach.
